items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: That's Sharky on trumpet, Mike Ryan on drums, myself on bass, Johnny Gregory on sax, and Johnny Miller on piano.

ctx.x: You recognize them? That's Sharky on trumpet, Mike Ryan on drums, myself on bass, Johnny Gregory on sax, and Johnny Miller on piano.
That looks like a baritone, huh?
